title: QUIC RFC 9000 Server Refusal And 0-RTT Pre-Initial Buffering Verification
verification_method: Focused S5P2P2 requirement-home tests, full S5P2P2 requirement-home regression filter, Release build, regenerated QUIC coverage triage, SpecTrace JSON validation, and whitespace diff checking.
scope: This verification covers deliberate listener refusal with a protected Initial CONNECTION_REFUSED close and bounded listener-local 0-RTT buffering before the matching Initial arrives.
expected_result: The requirement-home tests show a refused otherwise valid Initial receives a protected Initial CONNECTION_CLOSE carrying CONNECTION_REFUSED, accepted connections do not receive that refusal close, the refusal packet handles a shortest-client-CID edge while remaining padded to the Version 1 minimum, 0-RTT is classified for buffering only when capacity is configured, disabled buffering drops 0-RTT, and the buffer enforces the per-connection limit before draining for the late Initial.
procedure: Run the focused S5P2P2 0007/0008 requirement-home filter.
Run the full S5P2P2 requirement-home filter.
Check the resulting diff for whitespace errors.
preconditions: The listener still routes datagrams through endpoint ingress before pre-acceptance policy.
The client Initial used for loopback proof is protected and carries a valid ClientHello CRYPTO frame.
Retry bootstrap remains disabled for the bounded 0-RTT buffering path.

supplemental_sections.heading: Boundary
supplemental_sections.content: This verification does not claim 0-RTT decryption, early-data acceptance, anti-replay behavior, application delivery, public API widening, client-side Version Negotiation handling, preferred-address behavior, or hosted interop readiness.

status_summary: Passed locally on 2026-05-05. The Release build passed with 0 warnings and 0 errors, the focused S5P2P2 0007/0008 requirement-home filter passed 6/6, the full S5P2P2 filter passed 20/20, regenerated QUIC coverage triage marks S5P2P2 0001 through 0010 trace_clean, SpecTrace core validation passed for 412 JSON artifacts, and git diff --check passed with line-ending warnings only.
